items.summary:
## Summary

Follow-up to #1782, as agreed in https://github.com/OWASP/cve-lite-cli/pull/1782#issuecomment-7242540091.

If two findings need the same parent at different versions, the plan installs the higher one. Since #1782, a finding that was only checked at the lower version shows a warning and isn't counted as fixed. But nobody checks it at the higher version. So when the higher version fixes it too, the plan warns for no reason and says "1 of 2" instead of "all 2".
